requirements.text: The system shall provide a graphical user interface (GUI) that is fully controllable via both mouse and keyboard.
The system shall support multiple game types, including at least three default games: constructing, transforming, and marking.
The system shall allow users to select from multiple opening positions or a random opening position for each game.
The system shall support two-player games where each player can be either a human or an artificial intelligence (AI).
The system shall include a default random AI that selects legal moves at random.
The system shall allow users to change the nature of a player (human to AI or vice-versa) during an active game.
The system shall support loading new AI implementations from external files.
The system shall define games externally from the source code, allowing new games to be added without code modification.
The system shall terminate games based on predefined conditions and display the winner and scores.
The system shall provide functionality to save the current game state to a file and load a saved game from a file.
The system shall include an in-game help function providing rules and guidance.
The system's AI must calculate the next move within 10 seconds.
The system shall be compatible with Java 2 (version 1.4 or later) Runtime Environment.
The user interface shall be designed to be accessible to users with varying levels of technical experience.
The system shall require user confirmation before overwriting any existing files on the file system.
The system shall be released under the GPL license.
The system shall provide a user manual for players and a maintenance manual for developers.
